title: PAH-OMC-014 zero-mixture requires weak component sign crossing
question: For one fixed common cylinder, what necessary finite condition must a normalized nonnegative full-Q mixture satisfy if its scalar projective mismatch is exactly zero?
finding: Lean R505 proves that on a finite nonempty component block, nonnegative weights summing to one and an exactly zero weighted mismatch imply that some component mismatch d(i) is <=0 and some component mismatch d(j) is >=0. The integrated exact fixture uses weights (1/2,1/2) and mismatches (-1,1); the independent fixture uses weights (1/3,1/3,1/3) and mismatches (-2,0,2). Neither fixture is a PAH sector law or PAH mismatch vector.
decision_reason: R504 supplied a sufficient one-sided positive-separator obstruction, while R500-R503 separated kernel, positivity, witness-weight and finite-mixture-error obligations. R505 complements that obstruction with the necessary weak sign-crossing condition for any exact scalar cancellation. It narrows the future source-owner task without asserting the converse, choosing weights, or upgrading the route-local Q=0 result to a global no-go.
boundary: Conditional finite convex-hull diagnostic only. PAH-001 functional/rates, PAH-OMC-010 Gibbs weighting, PAH-OMC-012 full-Q graded domain/projection and PAH-OMC-014 order remain unchanged. R-484 hidden-diagonal defect 16/9 is retained and R-490 C_sw=540 remains domination-only. No source law, common embedding, tail estimate, projective equality, weak cylinder limit, positivity/normalization, stationarity, closability, semigroup, continuum or physical conclusion is claimed.
next_action: Obtain from a source owner the exact component mismatch vector for one fixed common cylinder and the independently specified normalized full-Q law/kernel; classify its finite convex hull using R504/R505, then supply the separate tail and Cauchy estimates required by PAH-OMC-014.
method: Hash-pin PAH-001, PAH-OMC-014, the projective-kernel obligation, the R504 separator manifest and the route-local Q=0 run.
Formalize the finite weightedMismatch sign implication for a nonempty finite component index type without inserting PAH values.
Compile R505 under Lean 4.32.1, register its exact source hash and reject escape tokens.
Replay independent exact rational zero fixtures and run integrated, independent and hostile mutation verifiers.
Retain HOLD_FOR_EVIDENCE because no source-owned law, mismatch vector, common embedding or tail estimate is present.
assumptions: The future component block is finite and nonempty and refers to one fixed bounded common cylinder.
The future component mismatch values are real and are evaluated before any weight fitting.
The future sector weights are nonnegative and normalized.
The fixed PAH-001 functional, boundary convention and limit order remain unchanged.
missing_assumptions: An exact source-owned mismatch vector for the declared full-Q component block.
A source-owned normalized nonnegative sector law or cross-Q stochastic kernel.
A source-owned one-sided separator or a convex-hull no-zero certificate if projective equality is to be ruled out.
A common embedding, tail control, topology/Cauchy estimate and stationarity domain for the ordered limit.
